description:
Products that have disappeared from a supermarket's catalogue in the
    given lookback window: delistings and range cuts.

    Args:
        store: "aldi" | "tesco" | "supervalu" | "dunnes" | "lidl".
        days_back: how many days back to consider (default 7).
        limit: how many removed products to return.
name: removed_products

id.description: Stable per-retailer product id, e.g. tesco:12345
id.title: Id

name.description: Product name as the retailer lists it
name.title: Name

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

unit_basis.description: The unit unit_price is measured in
unit_basis.title: Unit Basis

unit_price.description: Price per kg or per litre
unit_price.title: Unit Price

title: Delisted products
